name: FACET
summary: FACET is a separately named CMS dark-sector subdetector proposal in the forward region downstream of CMS at CERN. Website statistics should preserve its subsystem relationship rather than simply add it to the CMS main experiment.
detection_principle: A vacuum decay pipe behind long iron shielding would identify visible weakly coupled long-lived-particle decays using technologies similar to CMS upgrades.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
